0.name: High-Value Buyers
0.description: Returning visitors who view lots of pages, reach high-value pages and convert at the highest rate.
0.action: Protect the experience: loyalty perks, cross-sell/upsell, and a frictionless checkout.

1.name: Light Browsers
1.description: Returning visitors with short, shallow sessions and low purchase intent.
1.action: Surface bestsellers and personalised recommendations to deepen the visit.

2.name: Engaged Browsers
2.description: Returning visitors who browse deeply for a long time but rarely reach valuable pages.
2.action: Retarget with reminders, comparison tools and limited-time incentives to close the gap.

3.name: Bouncers
3.description: Land on the site and leave almost immediately: ~2 pages, a few seconds, very high bounce rate.
3.action: Improve landing-page relevance and load speed; review the traffic sources sending them.

4.name: New Visitor Prospects
4.description: First-time visitors with solid engagement and a surprisingly high purchase rate.
4.action: Welcome offers, onboarding content and email capture to turn them into returning customers.
